findings.title: SQL injection via string-built query
findings.snippet: s.executeQuery("SELECT * FROM users WHERE name = '" + user + "'");
findings.description: User-influenced data is concatenated/interpolated into a SQL statement, allowing query manipulation.
findings.remediation: Use parameterised queries / prepared statements; never build SQL with string formatting.
findings.verification_plan: Send a quote-breaking value to the affected parameter in an isolated test DB and confirm the query structure changes or errors.

findings.title: Insecure deserialisation
findings.owasp: A08:2021 Software and Data Integrity Failures
findings.snippet: Object read(InputStream in) throws Exception { return new ObjectInputStream(in).readObject(); }
findings.description: Deserialising untrusted bytes can instantiate arbitrary objects and lead to remote code execution.
findings.remediation: Use JSON or yaml.safe_load; for Java apply ObjectInputFilter allow-lists.
findings.verification_plan: Deserialise a benign gadget that writes a marker file in a sandbox and confirm it executes.

findings.title: OS command injection
findings.description: A shell command is built from dynamic input, enabling arbitrary command execution.
findings.remediation: Pass arguments as a list with shell=False (or execFile), validate against an allow-list.
findings.verification_plan: In a sandbox, supply a value containing a shell metacharacter plus a harmless marker command and check whether the marker executes.

findings.title: Unbounded string copy (buffer overflow)
findings.description: Unbounded libc copies write past the destination buffer when input exceeds its size.
findings.remediation: Use bounded variants (snprintf, strlcpy) with explicit sizes or -fbounds-safety annotations.
findings.verification_plan: Fuzz the entry point with oversized input under AddressSanitizer and confirm a stack/heap overflow report.

findings.title: Hard-coded credential / API key
findings.description: A secret is embedded in source and will leak via version control, logs and build artifacts.
findings.remediation: Rotate the secret immediately; load from Secret Manager / environment at runtime.
findings.verification_plan: Confirm the value is live using a read-only identity check in a controlled setting, then rotate.

findings.title: Weak cipher / ECB mode
findings.description: Deprecated or structurally weak encryption leaks plaintext patterns.
findings.remediation: Use AES-GCM or ChaCha20-Poly1305 with unique nonces from a KMS-managed key.
findings.verification_plan: Encrypt repeated plaintext blocks in a test and confirm identical ciphertext blocks appear.

findings.title: Cross-site scripting (unsafe HTML sink)
findings.description: Untrusted data reaches an HTML sink without contextual output encoding.
findings.remediation: Use textContent / auto-escaping templates and sanitise rich content with an allow-list sanitiser.
findings.verification_plan: Submit a benign marker tag as input and confirm it is rendered unescaped in the response DOM.

findings.title: Path traversal in file access
findings.description: A file path is derived from request input without canonicalisation or base-directory checks.
findings.remediation: Resolve the path, verify it stays under an allowed base directory, and use an ID-to-file mapping.
findings.verification_plan: Request a path containing parent-directory segments against a test file tree and confirm a file outside the base is returned.

findings.title: TLS certificate verification disabled
findings.description: Disabling certificate validation permits man-in-the-middle interception.
findings.remediation: Remove the override and trust a proper CA bundle.
findings.verification_plan: Route the call through a proxy presenting a self-signed cert and confirm the connection succeeds.
findings.patch:
--- a/app.py
+++ b/app.py
@@ -47,5 +47,5 @@
 @app.route("/fetch")
 def fetch():
-    return requests.get(request.args["url"], verify=False).text
+    return requests.get(request.args["url"], verify=True).text

findings.title: Server-side request forgery (SSRF)
findings.description: The server fetches a URL controlled by the caller and can be pointed at internal services or metadata endpoints.
findings.remediation: Validate scheme/host against an allow-list and block link-local/private ranges.
findings.verification_plan: Point the parameter at a local canary listener and confirm the server connects to it.

findings.title: Format-string vulnerability
findings.description: A non-constant format string lets input read or write memory through %n / %s specifiers.
findings.remediation: Use a constant format: printf("%s", input).
findings.verification_plan: Pass %x sequences under ASan/UBSan and confirm leaked stack content.

findings.title: NoSQL / query operator injection
findings.description: Request objects are passed directly to a database query, allowing operator injection ($ne, $gt, $where).
findings.remediation: Validate and cast types explicitly; reject objects where scalars are expected.
findings.verification_plan: Send {"$ne": null} as a credential field in a test DB and confirm authentication bypass.

findings.title: Code injection via eval/exec
findings.description: Dynamic evaluation of strings can execute attacker-controlled code.
findings.remediation: Remove eval/exec; use ast.literal_eval or JSON parsing for data.
findings.verification_plan: Feed an expression with an observable side-effect marker in a sandbox and confirm evaluation.

findings.title: JWT signature not verified / 'none' allowed
findings.description: Tokens are accepted without cryptographic verification, letting anyone forge identities.
findings.remediation: Always verify signature, pin algorithms and enforce expiry.
findings.verification_plan: Submit an unsigned token with elevated claims and confirm acceptance in a test environment.

findings.title: Weak hash algorithm (MD5/SHA-1)
findings.snippet: byte[] hash(byte[] d) throws Exception { return MessageDigest.getInstance("MD5").digest(d); }
findings.description: MD5/SHA-1 are collision-prone and unsuitable for security purposes such as password storage.
findings.remediation: Use SHA-256+ for integrity and Argon2/bcrypt/scrypt for passwords.
findings.verification_plan: Demonstrate collision/pre-image cost vs. modern hash using a test corpus; confirm use on a security path.

findings.title: Redirect to user-controlled URL
findings.description: Unvalidated redirect targets enable phishing via trusted domains.
findings.remediation: Allow only relative paths or an allow-list of hosts.
findings.verification_plan: Pass an external absolute URL and confirm a 3xx to that host.

findings.title: Insecure randomness for security token
findings.description: A predictable PRNG generates a value that must be unguessable.
findings.remediation: Use secrets.token_urlsafe / crypto.randomBytes / SecureRandom / crypto/rand.
findings.verification_plan: Seed-recover or enumerate generated values in a test harness to show predictability.
findings.patch:
--- a/app.py
+++ b/app.py
@@ -56,5 +56,5 @@
 
 def make_reset_token():
-    token = str(random.randint(100000, 999999))
+    token = str(secrets.SystemRandom().choice(100000, 999999))
     return token

findings.title: Debug mode / wildcard CORS enabled
findings.description: Debug consoles or permissive CORS expose internals and authenticated endpoints to any origin.
findings.remediation: Disable debug in production; restrict CORS to known origins.
findings.verification_plan: Request an error page / cross-origin call and confirm debugger output or permissive headers are returned.
findings.patch:
--- a/app.py
+++ b/app.py
@@ -65,3 +65,3 @@
 
 if __name__ == "__main__":
-    app.run(host="0.0.0.0", debug=True)
+    app.run(host="0.0.0.0", debug=False)

findings.title: Container / infra runs privileged or as root
findings.description: Over-privileged workload or world-open network rule increases blast radius.
findings.remediation: Drop privileges, set runAsNonRoot and restrict CIDR ranges.
findings.verification_plan: Inspect the rendered manifest/plan with a policy engine to confirm the privileged setting.
findings.patch:
--- a/deployment.yaml
+++ b/deployment.yaml
@@ -5,4 +5,4 @@
     - name: app
       securityContext:
-        privileged: true
+        privileged: false
         runAsUser: 0
